channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Frank Vogel | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Frank Vogel from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham, Frank Vogel
item.description:
“Remember, I got your Lakers games, you can’t hide them flaws they got. You just a dead man walking — they got rid of Frank Vogel who did a good job, they got rid of Darvin Ham who did a good job. You came out there thinking you were gonna change things with that same ugly girl you went on a date with – the Lakers stink.,”

Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham, Frank Vogel, Jan 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Udoka Azubuike on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Udoka Azubuike:

“It was basically my agent and the team spoke and from there, that’s how everything started, the process started. The coach (Suns coach Frank Vogel) liked my game and from there, that’s when everything started.”

Udoka Azubuike on Frank Vogel, Aug 13, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Suns owner Mat Ishbia on Frank Vogel as head coach:

“Frank is an accomplished coach who understands how to win an NBA championship, which is our priority.”

Mat Ishbia on Frank Vogel, Jun 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Justin Grasso:Doc Rivers on coaching change rumors around the league during the season:

“I think it’s disrespectful to all of the other coaches…. It makes our jobs so much harder. I think the Frank Vogel thing was so unfair…..it’s just not right and I hate it”

Doc Rivers on Frank Vogel, Apr 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @JGrasso_.

item.title: LeBron James on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Ryan Ward:LeBron on Frank Vogel:

“I respect Frank as a coach and as a man. ... I have nothing but respect for him.”

LeBron James on Frank Vogel, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Malik Monk on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Lakers SGMalik Monk on Frank Vogel:

“I love the man. He gave me a chance. This was the only team that called me in the offseason and gave me a chance. I have nothing bad to say about him. All praise goes to him. If it wasn't for him, I wouldn't have a chance to play basketball.”

Malik Monk on Frank Vogel, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Rob Pelinka on Frank Vogel learning of being fired in a tweet:

“We don't respond to unsourced media reports. And in terms of the timing of that decision, we're going to keep that internal.”

Rob Pelinka on Frank Vogel, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“I think the communication of what (Vogel) wants and how he wants it kind of changes because guys have been in and out of the lineup,”

Russell Westbrook on Frank Vogel, Jan 21, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Frank Vogel
item.description:
LeBron James on Frank Vogel and the coaching staff:

“The coaching staff has been great. They’ve put us in a position to succeed.”

LeBron James on Frank Vogel, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“I came back in the second quarter and it was hurting a little bit more. And then after halftime, I finally took my sock off to look and my whole toenail was gone. So, it was just all bad from there. I couldn't walk or run. So I just told Coach [Frank Vogel] to take me out.”

Andre Drummond on Frank Vogel, Apr 1, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Andre Drummond on the Lakers defense, after a chat he had with Frank Vogel:

“I think our defense is going to be really crazy when those guys come back. I'm looking forward to it… my defensive game is going to help this team a lot – my quick feet, my quick hands.”

Andre Drummond on Frank Vogel, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Wes Matthews on Frank Vogel:

“He's a very personable coach. Very in tune with his players. Very adaptable. Demands excellence and that is what you want... demands the most of the players. Great communicator. So far, everything smooth.”

Wesley Matthews on Frank Vogel, Dec 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“I think Frank Vogel and his coaching staff have made it clear that the identity of this team is centered on defense and just playing gritty, tenacious basketball,”

Rob Pelinka on Frank Vogel, Dec 5, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“(Vogel) spends hours and hours of watching film, breaking down games, schemes, figuring out what’s the best recipe for us to be successful,”

Anthony Davis on Frank Vogel, Sep 27, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: LeBron James on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“Since training camp, coach [Frank] Vogel and the coaching staff came in and said we wanted to be one of the best defensive teams, if not the best, in the league and that’s where it starts at for us,”

LeBron James on Frank Vogel, Sep 9, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Frank Vogel:

“Frank's always been an innovator. I've stolen quite a few things from him in my time.”

Steve Kerr on Frank Vogel, Nov 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Frank Vogel
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“I called Frank Vogel the day I drove to the gym, when we played Milwaukee, and just asked him, 'What are some of the things that Paul did in his year off that you would really encourage? What are some of the things that we should be looking [to]?' And, hey, [Hayward is] going to be the best guy shooting out of a chair, with his left hand, with his right hand, perfect his form, and let's have fun. Let's come up with creative ways to attack this thing.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Frank Vogel, Oct 20, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Here’s what Nikola Vucevic had to say regarding tonight’s lineup change.

“I spoke to Frank [Vogel] about it last night, and obviously I wasn't happy with the decision they made,”

Nikola Vucevic on Frank Vogel, Nov 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @ZachOliverNBA.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“He's a guy that works hard from what [Mahinmi] said. [Vogel's] always positive. Just a great coach to be around.”

Evan Fournier on Frank Vogel, May 25, 2016. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Frank Vogel
item.description:
“While we were conducting our search,it became very evident that Frank (Vogel) is a terrific fit for our organization,”

Rob Hennigan on Frank Vogel, May 20, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Indy head coach Frank Vogel:

“He's a good friend and a good coach and I've learned a lot from him the last two years.”

Brad Stevens on Frank Vogel, Nov 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Paul George on Larry Bird, Frank Vogel
item.description:
Paul George on meeting w/ Vogel & Bird:

“There was clarification on what we’re (doing) going forward. That’s what it was, just clarification.”

Paul George on Larry Bird, Frank Vogel, Oct 5, 2015. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Lance Stephenson on Frank Vogel
item.description:
Lance Stephenson said after Sunday's practice.

“After coach (Frank Vogel) barked at us and got on us and showed us all the clips of how we looked on defense, we definitely had to pick it up for next game.”

Lance Stephenson on Frank Vogel, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Shane Battier on LeBron James, Danny Granger, Frank Vogel
item.description:
Frank Vogel says everybody’s talking about LeBron's defense on Danny Granger but nobody's talking Shane Battier's defense on Granger:

“We put some different looks in just to try to get (Granger) freed up from LeBron but also from Battier,'' Vogel said.”

Shane Battier on LeBron James, Danny Granger, Frank Vogel, May 15, 2012. Source: Sulia.
